typography.font_characteristics: heavy display for hooks (optionally pixel/mono); geometric sans for support; dual-tone white + terminal green

dual_tone.rule: Key nouns/verbs in near-white bold; accent words or secondary lines in terminal green. In-frame dual-tone is primary; karaoke pill is slim support.

color.background_treatment: flat near-black void; optional subtle scanline or grid at ~4% opacity
color.accent_usage: single terminal green for keywords, list headers, UI chrome only

motion_graphics.zoom_behavior: slow push-in on cards; punch-in on keyword reveals
overlays: optional scanline overlay at low opacity
motion_graphics.borders: 1px #39FF14 hairlines on terminal cards; no thick white sticker outline required
motion_graphics.gradients: none on canvas; soft shadow falloff only
motion_graphics.shadows: soft diffuse under host and cards (y+8..20, blur 30..60, opacity ~0.35)

audio.bgm: optional light bed ducked under VO

hierarchy.visual_hierarchy: graphic/kinetic upper-mid → host lower-left → slim karaoke above safe zone → empty footer
hierarchy.emphasis_timing: caption words land with stressed syllables; host expression swaps on scene boundaries

watermark.footer_policy: leave bottom 8% clear unless user supplies their own brand

notes: Dark character-hosted explainer. Alive host playback. No GREENCODE/PATTERN chrome. No concept leak. Chroma-key green.
